verdict.rationale: The product documents automation in CI through the Codex SDK and terminal-based automation through the Codex CLI, including per-run flags and a scriptable bulk-scan command. These are thin, single-line claims, though, with no detailed documentation of a non-interactive or headless run mode and no independent corroboration, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless exec mode, CI authentication and setup details, output/exit-code handling for pipelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the Codex SDK to automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI.
Inspect code, make changes, run commands, and automate repeatable work without leaving your terminal.
In the CLI, pass `--search` to fetch live results for one run
Use `npx @openai/codex-security bulk-scan` to review repositories in one campaign.
